question: A man sold 30 articles for Rs. 100 and gained 20%. The number of articles he bought for Rs. 100 was:
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price = Rs. 100

Profit = 20%

Sold articles = 30

**Formula used:**

P% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

SP of 30 articles =Rs. 100

SP of 1 article = 100/3 = 10/3

⇒ 20 = [(10/3 - CP)/CP] × 100

⇒ CP = 25/9

∵ CP of 1 article = 25/9

∴ Number of articles = [(100)/(25/9)]

∴ The number of articles = 36

Hence,

**36 articles bought in Rs. 100**
